findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (House roll call 759, passed 66-47)
findings.note: The member's vote column shows No on House passage of HB 958. Part II of the ratified bill (staff summary at https://dashboard.ncleg.gov/api/Services/BillSummary/2025/H958-SMST-37(rat)-v-8) has DMV send full social security numbers to the elections board monthly, requires removal of deceased voters, requires a process to remove non-eligible citizens found in a federal database, and bars processing a registration unless the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship (a sworn form if left blank). Bill page: https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958. Veto status is on the bill page (see the 2026-08-17 veto finding).
subjects: removal of non-citizens from voter rolls

findings.motion: HB 958 vetoed by the Governor 2026-08-17 (context only; the member's votes on the bill are in the two findings above)
findings.note: Bill page shows ratified 2026-08-06 and vetoed 2026-08-17. No member vote on a veto override of HB 958 appears on the member's vote list as reviewed. This is context for the two votes above, not an act of the member.

findings.motion: HB 1246 Safeguarding Elections Act, filed 2026-07-30, primary sponsor group (Buansi, Dahle, F. Jackson, Clark)
findings.note: Bill page lists Clark in the primary sponsor group; referred to House Rules 2026-08-04, no further action. Text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H1246v0.pdf) includes a Class 2 misdemeanor for demanding citizenship documentation from a voter other than what State law requires, a new citizenship ground for voter challenges, and a rule that voter photo-ID photographs and photocopies of ID for voting are confidential and not released to the federal government without a court order or warrant. It also covers voter intimidation, early voting hours, certification and forensic audits.
subjects: confidentiality of voter photo ID records
